backup.heading: Database backup and restore
backup.local_database_warning: Backup and restore is designed for remote databases (libsql://). You are currently using a local database.
backup.storage_not_configured: Storage is not configured. Backups require Bunny CDN or local storage to be enabled.
backup.encryption_key_description: You will need this key to restore a backup to a different site. Store it securely — it cannot be recovered.
backup.create_backup_description: Creates a .zip archive containing a .sql file for each database table. Backups are not encrypted (the sensitive contents are already encrypted at the field level).
backup.create_too_large:
This database is now too big to back up from this page. A full backup needs about {needed} database calls. One page request only allows {available}.

Run deno task backup from a checkout of this app instead. Backups made that way still appear on this page.
backup.create_too_large_error: This database is too big to back up from this page. Run deno task backup from a checkout of this app instead.
backup.listing_error: Could not read the list of backups: {error}
backup.stored_in_folder: Backups for this database live in the {folder} folder.
backup.stored_in_zone: Backups for this database live in the {folder} folder of the {zone} storage zone.
backup.restore_console_description:
Run deno task restore <backup.zip> from a checkout of this app. Put the target database's DB_URL and DB_TOKEN in .env first.

A restore cannot run on this page because a large restore exceeds the edge request limit.
backup.retention_count: {count, plural, one {There is 1 backup} other {There are # backups}}
backup.retention_kept: , shown newest first. Up to {maxBackups} are kept —
backup.retention_remaining: {remaining} more can be created before the oldest is purged.
backup.retention_purge: the next will purge the oldest ({oldest}).
